desc.zh: 从两枚鸡蛋与六层楼，推导固定次数能覆盖多少楼层。
desc.en: From two eggs and six floors, derive how many floors a move budget can cover.

complexity: O(kM) time; O(k) auxiliary space, where M is the minimum move count and M <= n

concepts.name: Descending rolling DP
concepts.description: Preserve previous-move operands in one array.
